adjudication.rationale: In the new helper `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts), it returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error? }`), not the parsed token object (`data`). In GoogleCalendarService, the code assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and persists it directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. This will store the wrapper object instead of the credential payload (previously it used `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)`), corrupting the stored credentials structure on refresh.
